messages:
Grace (PM): Quick customer note: when switching Org -> Project the spend panel collapses and hides the 'View invoices' button behind the right rail. They expect invoice actions to be persistent. Screenshot: https://files.internal/redwood/spend-hidden-cta.png

Avi (Designer): Proposed responsive: compact mode shows top-3 token chips + a single "+more" pill; expanded mode shows full legend. Keep invoice CTA pinned left in header for <=920px widths. Mock: https://figma.com/redwood/compact-spend

Omar (Frontend): Pinned CTA ok but must be first in DOM for keyboard users. I'll add a feature flag (persistedInvoiceCTA) and include focus-return logic for modals. Also add aria-expanded on the +more pill.

Lina (Billing): Important: invoices CTA should remain high-contrast and visible only to billing_admins. Also ensure CSV export includes scope column and preserves legend order. We had a support ticket when project IDs were missing.

Avi (Designer): Added notes for chip truncation: show currency amount and percent on hover. For large token sets we default to top-3 by USD and let users open a modal to see full list.

Omar (Frontend): Implementation plan: storybook stories for compact and expanded, keyboard tests, and a small E2E that validates pinned CTA presence for billing_admin. ETA: next Wed.

Grace (PM): Action items: @Avi update mocks with pinned CTA state and a11y hints, @Omar add feature flag + tests, @Lina share CSV schema required. Follow-up sync Fri 9am PT. Thanks :white_check_mark:

BotInvoice: Invoice #INV-2026-999 generated: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-999.json

Omar (Frontend): noted — I'll open a draft PR with the feature flag and include QA checklist entries.
